facts.fact: The World Bank and African Development Bank diagnostic of Mozambique's data governance, with evidence updated to spring 2025, refers to the government's preparation of a draft Data Protection Law and recommends that it adopt a data protection law, so none was in force; the document gives no date for the draft, so its 2025-12-09 publication date and spring 2025 evidence cut-off are used.

note: carried from dataprotectionlaw; no document opened
